# ===========================================
# ozaMenu - Environment Variables
# ===========================================
# Copy this file to .env.local and fill in your values
# NEVER commit .env.local to version control!

# -------------------------------------------
# Supabase Configuration
# -------------------------------------------
# Get these values from Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API

# Supabase Project URL
# Example: https://your-project-ref.supabase.co
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=

# Supabase Anonymous (Public) Key
# This key is safe to use in client-side code (protected by RLS)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=

# Supabase Service Role Key (KEEP SECRET!)
# This key bypasses RLS - ONLY use in server-side code
# NEVER expose this key to the client/browser
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=

# -------------------------------------------
# Application Configuration
# -------------------------------------------

# Site URL (used for auth redirects and QR code generation)
# Development: http://localhost:3000
# Production: https://e-menum.net
SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000

# -------------------------------------------
# Optional: Development Settings
# -------------------------------------------

# Enable debug mode (development only)
# DEBUG=true

task_intent.title: 037-add-search-to-categories-page
task_intent.description: Add search functionality to the categories page, allowing users to filter categories by name. This mirrors the existing search pattern already implemented in the products page.
